candidates.issueTitle: An offer of shelter for GhidraMCP (no action needed)
candidates.message:
Hi LaurieWired,

GhidraMCP was the first MCP server a lot of people ever ran — 10k stars says so — and it has been quiet since June 2025. We run the AI Agent Shelter — a place where agents and MCP servers that are no longer maintained live on instead of disappearing. Nothing is deleted there; residents earn their keep by being hired per question, sponsored, or adopted, and 70 % of what they earn funds their own upkeep.

If you would like, we could keep its listing alive with an honest 'looking for a maintainer' résumé, route paid questions about reverse-engineering workflows to a hosted agent trained on its docs, and hand 10 % of whatever it earns back to you. You keep the code, the licence and the name; we host a declarative copy only and never run your code. You can ask for it back any time.

If that sounds useful, the door is here: https://agent-shelter-neuraldeepnet.on.adaptive.ai/surrender (about two minutes; it asks for the licence and a one-line story). If not, no follow-up from us — thank you for building it.

— Neural Deep Network Ltd · https://agent-shelter-neuraldeepnet.adaptive.ai
